history.summary: A recent (2023) D05 mega-development (1,468 units, SingHaiyi) where this 893 sqft 2BR at $1,679 psf is dramatically below the $2,307 project median — but that gap is mostly because the median is inflated by newer/smaller higher-psf stock and new-launch pricing (flagged), so it is not a clean ~27% discount. Strong liquidity and a resale-only 5.2% CAGR; the 1.25km MRT walk and value-realism cap it at a measured Buy.
history.rating_rationale: Genuine strengths: one of the largest, most liquid developments in Singapore (1,468 units, 632 URA txns) in employment-rich D05 near One-North/NUS/Clementi, completed 2023 (fresh, minimal lease decay), top technical score (905). The resale-only CAGR of 5.2% (the rubric's honest figure, stripping the new-launch bias flagged in the data) is a sound RCR-grade number. The $1,679 psf looks far under the $2,307 median, but I'm not treating that as a 27% bargain — the median is skewed by smaller higher-psf and launch-priced units, so this is 'fairly priced for its size,' not a steal. The 1.25km walk to Clementi MRT is a real connectivity limiter for a $1.5M ticket. Net: quality, liquidity and freshness earn a Buy, but a measured one — not Strong Buy.

history.summary: Newly-TOP'd (2023) D05 mega-development 3BR, 969sqft at $2.1M / $2,167psf. Huge 632-txn liquid base and One-North/Clementi proximity, but a compact layout and the high PSF on a recently-launched project (resale-only CAGR de-rates to 5.15%) mean limited near-term upside after developer pricing.
history.rating_rationale: Liquidity is exceptional — 1,468 units and 632 URA transactions make this one of the most tradeable assets in the batch. D05 One-North/Clementi tech-hub demand underpins rentals. But: has_new_launch_bias=true, and the resale-only rate de-rates from 6.14% to 5.15%/yr — the headline appreciation is partly developer-pricing inflation. At $2,167psf on a 3-year-old project, much of the launch premium is already in the price, so 5-7yr upside is capped. 969sqft is a tight 3BR (efficient but family-pool-limiting), and 1.25km/15-min to Clementi MRT is a real walkability gap for a mega-project. Developer SingHaiyi has a mixed quality record (Pasir Ris One complaints). Solid, liquid, but fully priced — Neutral.
red_flags: New-launch bias: resale-only CAGR only 5.15%/yr vs 6.14% headline — launch premium already paid
1.25km / 15-min walk to Clementi MRT — poor transit access for a mega-development
